title: Normalize Forms Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize forms/plugin/rs/** (and forms/** fixtures if any) to the repo-wide Consistency Contract: C1 app-struct naming, C2 single 🔖Manifest region, C3 exact region markers + canonical order (Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests), C4 single-app crate stays flat, C5 replace hand-rolled tree_item/selection_ids/PanelKit, LocaleLabels/app_labels!/AppLabelsOverlayExt terminology, and testkit meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/undo-redo/convergence/idempotency scaffolding with the real semio_framework_plugin SDK primitives (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs). First fix/verify the known broken import (forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs previously imported ProtocolBuilderConfig/PROTOCOL_BUILDER_LABELS_EN/render_protocol_builder/BlockPaletteEntry from semio_framework_plugin instead of the protocol domain crate after Wave 1's SDK extraction) — ticket 26/07/18/FIX-FORMS-PLUGIN-SDK-IMPORTS may already cover this. Do not touch other apps' crates, framework/**, or ui/**.
summary:
Normalized forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs (2741 -> 2526 lines) to the repo Consistency Contract, mirroring the already-landed draw/flow/protocol plugin crates exactly:

1. Verified the known broken-import ticket (26/07/18/FIX-FORMS-PLUGIN-SDK-IMPORTS): already fixed correctly (protocol:: for ProtocolBuilderConfig/PROTOCOL_BUILDER_LABELS_EN/render_protocol_builder, semio_framework_plugin:: re-export for BlockPaletteEntry) — closed that ticket as verified/superseded.
2. Found and fixed a genuine, separate compile blocker while adopting PanelKit: UiTreeItemNode gained a `loading: Option<bool>` field upstream, and every hand-rolled struct literal in build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree was missing it (a non-exhaustive struct literal is a hard compile error). Root-fixed by rewriting both functions on semio_framework_plugin::{PanelTreeBuilder, tree_item_with_action} (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs PanelKit region), which always initializes it via UiTreeItemNode::base.
3. Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled FormsLabels struct + FORMS_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + forms_labels() resolver with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!{} + resolve_labels::<FormsLabels>(view_state); replaced forms_action_labels/forms_utility_labels' manual iter().map().collect() with localized_label_map; rewrote DocumentApp::app_labels() on the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (with_framework_panel_tabs + .window_kind_label/.mode_label/.action_labels/.utility_labels/.example_labels).
4. setSelection action handler now uses semio_framework_plugin::selection_ids(args) instead of a hand-rolled ids-array parse.
5. Testkit: removed local meta()/new_app_with_registry() bodies in favor of thin delegates to semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{new_app, new_app_with_registry}; all call sites now use testkit::meta(...); add_question_undo_redo_round_trip now uses testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip; two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits rewritten on testkit::assert_two_instances_converge (dropped the manual MemoryBackbone::pair/attach_backbone/load_document scaffolding), matching protocol-plugin's already-landed migrated version of the same test.
6. C1: app struct was already correctly named FormsPlayApp for app id "forms-play" — no rename needed.
7. C2/C3: renamed the registration region 🔖AppFactory -> 🔖Manifest; regions reordered into the canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> FormsPlayApp -> Manifest -> Tests order (previously Constants -> Runtime -> Helpers(+Contributions) -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Builder -> TryWizard -> Panels -> FormsPlayApp -> AppFactory -> Tests); split the old Runtime region into Types (FormsPlayRuntime struct) + folded its functions into DocumentHelpers alongside the old Helpers region content; merged Builder+TryWizard into a single Render region with Builder/TryWizard as nested subregions. 🧪Tests region naming was already correct.
8. C4: single-app crate (only one `impl DocumentApp for X`) — confirmed it stays flat, no wrapping `pub mod` added.
9. C5: confirmed zero residual local tree_item/tree_item_with_action/selection_ids/meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/hand-rolled Labels struct+resolver/hand-rolled label-map fn/MemoryBackbone::pair scaffolding remains — all now sourced from semio_framework_plugin.
10. C6: Cargo.toml deps unchanged (forms, vcs, protocol, semio-framework-plugin, semio-framework-core, serde, serde_json) — protocol is a shared domain crate, not another app's plugin crate; no violation.
11. .resource_kind(...) on the AppBuilder chain was already present (form.dictionary) — verified, not touched.

VERIFIED: region-marker balance and canonical order (scripted check), brace/paren/bracket balance (scripted), rustfmt --edition 2021 --config-path rustfmt.toml (noisy but pre-existing repo-wide — draw/plugin/rs/lib.rs, an already-accepted normalized crate, shows the same style of diff, so not a regression signal), exhaustive function-name diff against a pre-edit backup (confirms exactly two removals — forms_labels, meta — and zero accidental additions/removals of any other function), exhaustive #[test] fn name diff against backup (all 30 tests preserved, none renamed/dropped), all 52 FormsLabels fields cross-referenced as used, all imported semio_framework_plugin symbols cross-referenced as used (removed one now-unused import, tree_item_with_action_draggable), every new SDK call site's argument types manually checked against the real signatures read from framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit regions and framework/core/rs/lib.rs's AppLabelsOverlay::with_framework_panel_tabs, and every transformation pattern-matched 1:1 against the already-landed sibling crates draw/plugin/rs/lib.rs, flow/plugin/rs/lib.rs, and protocol/plugin/rs/lib.rs.

SKIPPED: `cargo check -p forms-plugin` did not return within ~8 minutes (stuck on the shared build lock per the documented 100+ concurrent cargo sessions) — backgrounded and abandoned per the verification policy; a full cargo check/test sweep is left to the orchestrator's final gate.

NOT CLEANLY EXPRESSIBLE WITH EXISTING SDK PRIMITIVES: none found for this crate — PanelKit, Terminology/app_labels!, AppLabelsOverlayExt, selection_ids, and testkit all had a real, exact-fit use in forms-plugin with no gaps or awkward workarounds needed.
